grades: Entering grades 9 to 12 (or a high school graduate of that year)
name: Point Park Sports Business Camp
what_you_do: Three days of learning about jobs in sports business. People who work for local teams like the Pirates, Penguins, Steelers and Riverhounds teach you. Each day has a behind-the-scenes tour of a sports site.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 in the fall, and/or recent high school graduates. No age requirement is listed.
pay_detail: Tuition is free (paid by the Rowland School of Business and Brentwood Bank). A $25 non-refundable registration fee holds your spot.
duration: 3 days (2026: June 29 to July 1), day or residential
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 29 to July 1, 2026 and was full with a waitlist. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register at app.campdoc.com/register/pointpark and pay the $25 fee. Contact summercamps@pointpark.edu or 412-392-3456.
notes: Bring some cash for snacks and off-campus activities. The page showed the 2025 schedule. Instructor: Robert Derda, M.S.
org: Point Park University (Rowland School of Business)
